notes.title: Entodrive Community Update #6
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DRcLbK-EG50;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello Entodrive players!
Here's what I've been working on for this update :

[h2]Music :[/h2]
I have replaced about half of the game's soundtrack with new music. Most of the new music was made by Liam Bradbury from his Complete RPG Chiptunes Pack. Special thank you to him for providing new music for the game.

[h2]Battle Animations[/h2]
Monster animations are no longer just idle loops on the battle screen. Player & Enemy monsters will now display hit and attack animations. I may improve on this in the future with physical/special/status attack anim variants. Making these animation changes I actually cut about 3.5 seconds of mandatory time while in battle. I also changed it so that you can select a move by double clicking instead of using the confirm button in battle. Battles should be quicker and more responsive now. 

[h2]Momentum Changes[/h2]
To prevent falling down slopes, I've applied more static friction to the base player movement. To coincide with this I've also changed it so you can only move in one direction at a time. Before you could apply force in two directions doubling your speed, which caused glitches and exploits.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Set a limit to how far the player can fall, so it will now reroute out of bounds players to the nearest map on that level. I fixed a crash when Entodrive report cards are read instantly when just loading a level. Fixed a crash when following Entodrive aren't spawned on a nav mesh. 

[h2]Steam Guide NPCS[/h2]
I've added Steam Guide helper NPCs around Cache Isle that give you hints about the game and resources to help you. They will also be present around areas that have seasonal events so you can know what time of the year to come back and where.

[h2]Lost During Your Playthrough?[/h2]

Check out the steam guides :
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2472674974
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2603495916

If you have any issues or bugs during your playthrough please reach out here on the Steam forums and I'll do my best to fix your issues swiftly. 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1520710/discussions/2/

Thank you everyone for over 3 years of support on Entodrive! The sequel Entodrive : Auburn is currently in production! There's some wip footage on my youtube channel you can check out. I'll keep you updated on its development and bring you some community updates to the original game along the way!

[h2]What I've been working on :[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40007778/ed8246153da36bbaa39102c8d9c3a533541322ca.png[/img]
+Added the XPLink, which can be enabled when you get the key item and enter your storage system
+The XPLink shares half of the gained experience in battle to the other 3 slots in your crew!
+You can now enter the Lighthouse in Spark harbor after the powerplant event!

+For players who want to have an XPLink at the start of a new game go to the debug menu! :)

+SaveManager Fixes :
[i]Refactoring -[/i]
SetIntHapSave, for setting instance variables like gamestate that increment when conditions are greater than the previous state.
Before it was casting save information rather than calling my getintsave function which returns the save values without an extra cast. This would sometimes cause a null ref error forcing a crash.

[i]Error State Prevention -[/i]
It's painful to watch a streamer try to play your game, but the game bumps them into an error state reloading the scene as is, and sets the save file to an empty one. It's rough..
I've determined that there are some gameobjects that when searching for a save key value pair would do so after the save manager had either already started switching levels or would be in the middle of saving something.
To prevent I've added more protection cases for saving.
The game will no longer save if connection to the save script is loss. This could happen from alt tab and scripts not loading in correctly causing the save manager to enter an error state and save data as nothing.
Now if the save attempts to save file as nothing and it isn't the new game function it will cancel the save. Clicking the save button in some cases will now fix the error state and reconnect the save script.
Likewise exiting the game and relaunching should as well.. Your mileage may very. If you are a user struggling with save issues, please lmk how these changes effect your game.

+Optimizations Fixes :
Rebuilt occlusion for some scenes.
Removed background clutter that would cause crashes.
Removed background grass that would in some cases remain active
Removed background geometry that wasn't actually visible.
Removal of mandatory get component calls for scene optimization (this will need more work.)
